description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'VehicleFragment' which displays a list of vehicles using RecyclerView. It loads vehicle data from internal storage (JSON formatted), parses it, and populates the UI with vehicle details via a custom adapter.

classes.name: VehicleFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of vehicles loaded from internal storage. It manages UI components and data parsing for vehicle information.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of VehicleFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes RecyclerView, and loads vehicle data.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Reads JSON vehicle data from internal storage, parses it, creates ListItem objects, and sets up the RecyclerView adapter.
